title: CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream

paragraphs.en: On the morning of the final examination results release at Queen's, Anne and Jane walked together. Jane was cheerful; she believed she had passed comfortably and was not concerned about further outcomes. Anne, however, looked pale and quiet.
paragraphs.zh: 在女王学院放榜的早晨，安妮和简一起散步。简心情愉快；她相信自己成绩不错，对其他结果并不在意。然而，安妮显得面色苍白，神情安静。

paragraphs.en: She knew Emily Clay would win the Avery medal, and she lacked the courage to check the bulletin board herself.
paragraphs.zh: 她知道埃米莉·克莱将会赢得艾弗里奖章，而自己缺乏勇气亲自去查看布告板。

paragraphs.en: "Of course you'll get one of them," said Jane, puzzled by the faculty's fairness.
paragraphs.zh: 简疑惑不已，说道：“当然你会得到其中一位。”

paragraphs.en: "I don't expect the Avery," replied Anne. "I'm going straight to the girls' dressing room. You must read the announcements quickly and tell me."
paragraphs.zh: “我不指望阿维里那边有消息，”安妮回答道，“我直接去女孩子们的更衣室。你得快点看公告，告诉我结果。”

paragraphs.en: Jane solemnly promised but found no need for it. As they climbed Queen’s steps, boys carried Gilbert Blythe on their shoulders, shouting, “Hurrah for Blythe, Medalist!”
paragraphs.zh: 简庄重地许下了诺言，但最终并未派上用场。当他们登上王后台阶时，一群男孩将吉尔伯特·布雷思抬在肩上，大声喊着：“为布雷思喝彩，奖牌得主！”

paragraphs.en: Anne felt a pang of defeat when she saw this. Gilbert had won! Matthew would be disappointed—he had been so sure Anne would win.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮看到这一幕时，心中不禁一阵失落。吉尔伯特赢了！马修会感到失望的——他曾如此坚信安妮会获胜。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, someone shouted:
paragraphs.zh: 突然，有人喊道：

paragraphs.en: "Three cheers for Miss Shirley, winner of the Avery!"
paragraphs.zh: “为希里尔小姐三声喝彩，她赢得了埃维奖！”

paragraphs.en: Jane gasped as they fled to the girls' dressing room amid cheers. "Oh, Anne," she exclaimed. "Isn't it splendid?"
paragraphs.zh: 简在欢呼声中仓皇逃到女更衣室，喘息道：“哦，安妮，”她脱口而出，“这不是太棒了吗？”

paragraphs.en: The girls surrounded them, and Anne became the center of a laughing, congratulating group. Amidst the commotion, she whispered to Jane.
paragraphs.zh: 女孩们围了上来，安妮成了一个欢笑祝贺的小团体的中心。在一片喧闹中，她低声对简说道。

paragraphs.en: Anne returned home to Avonlea with Matthew and Marilla after her graduation ceremony. The exercises had been held at the Academy's assembly hall, where she read the best essay and was celebrated as the Avery winner.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮在毕业典礼后与马修和玛丽拉回到了埃文利。她在学院的集会厅参加了毕业仪式，朗读了最佳论文，并被授予阿very奖，受到了热烈的庆祝。

paragraphs.en: Matthew whispered to Marilla, "Reckon you're glad we kept her, Marilla?"
paragraphs.zh: 马修小声对玛丽拉说：“你觉得我们留下的那个女孩挺好的吧，玛丽拉？”

paragraphs.en: Marilla replied, "It’s not the first time I’ve been glad." Miss Barry, sitting behind them, leaned forward and poked Marilla with her parasol. "Aren't you proud of that Anne-girl?
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回答说：“这并不是我第一次感到自豪。”她们身后坐着的巴里小姐探过身来，用她的雨伞戳了戳玛丽拉。“你不为那个安妮女孩感到骄傲吗？”

paragraphs.en: I am," she said.
paragraphs.zh: “我就是，”她说。

paragraphs.en: That evening, Anne went home to Avonlea, feeling eager to see Diana at Green Gables. In her white room, where a flowering house rose adorned the window sill, Anne breathed deeply and exclaimed, "Oh, Diana, it's so good to be back again. It’s wonderful to see those pointed firs against the pink sky—and that white orchard and the old Snow Queen."
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，安妮回到了埃文利的绿山墙农舍，心里满是见到戴安娜的迫不及待。在她那间洁白的房间里，窗台上绽放着一丛丛盛开的花朵，安妮深吸了一口气，脱口而出：“哦，戴安娜，回来的感觉真好。看到那些尖顶松树映衬在粉红色的天空下，还有那片雪白的果园和老雪皇后屋，真是太美妙了。”

paragraphs.en: Diana remarked, "I thought you liked Stella Maynard better than me." Anne laughed and threw her bouquet of faded June lilies at Diana. "Stella is the dearest girl in the world except for you," she said.
paragraphs.zh: 戴安娜说道：“我还以为你更喜欢斯蒂拉·梅纳德呢。”安妮笑了笑，把一束枯萎的六月百合花扔给了戴安娜。“除了你，斯蒂拉是我这个世界上最爱的女孩。”她说。

paragraphs.en: "I love you more than ever—and I have so many things to tell you."
paragraphs.zh: “我比以往更爱你了，还有很多事情想告诉你。”

paragraphs.en: Anne felt tired from being studious and ambitious, vowing to spend two hours lying in the orchard grass, thinking of nothing. "You've done splendidly, Anne," Diana said. "I suppose you won't be teaching now that you’ve won the Avery?"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮感到自己因勤奋好学和雄心壮志而有些疲惫，决定躺在果园的草地上，什么都不想。戴安娜说道：“你做得真是太棒了，安妮。我想你现在应该不会去教书了吧？”

paragraphs.en: Anne was excited about her plans for September, envisioning a fresh start after three months of vacation. She learned that Jane and Ruby would be teaching, and Gilbert Blythe would also join them as he needed to earn his own way through school. Anne felt a pang of loss at the thought of losing their competitive spirit.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮对九月的计划兴奋不已，期待着三个月假期后的全新开始。她得知简和ruby将会任教，而吉尔伯特·布雷思也会加入他们，因为他需要靠自己的努力赚取学费。一想到失去与他们的竞争精神，安妮心中不禁涌起一丝失落。

paragraphs.en: At breakfast the next morning, Anne noticed Matthew looked unwell. He seemed grayer than before. She hesitated but asked Marilla if Matthew was alright.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早餐时，安妮注意到马修看起来不太舒服。他显得比以前更苍白了一些。她犹豫了一下，还是问玛丽拉马修是不是出了什么问题。

paragraphs.en: Marilla replied that Matthew had experienced some heart issues this spring and wasn't taking care of himself. However, he was improving with a good hired man's help.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉说，马修今年春天曾有一些心脏方面的问题，并没有好好照顾自己，好在有位得力的雇工帮忙照料，情况正在好转。

paragraphs.en: Anne then observed Marilla herself didn’t look well. Concerned about her mother’s health, Anne suggested she needed to rest now that she was home. She planned to spend the day revisiting old places and chasing her dreams, while Marilla could relax when it was her turn to work.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮随后观察到，玛丽拉自己看起来也不太好。她担心母亲的健康，建议现在回家后应该好好休息一下。安妮打算利用这一天重温旧地，追逐自己的梦想，而当轮到玛丽拉工作时，她可以放松一下。

paragraphs.en: Marilla smiled affectionately at her daughter, understanding her intentions.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉亲切地微笑着看着女儿，理解她的意图。

paragraphs.en: Anne's headaches have worsened, causing her difficulty in reading and sewing. Dr. Spencer suggested seeing a distinguished oculist who will visit the Island at the end of June. Anne acknowledges her success at Queen's, earning a First Class License and winning the Avery scholarship.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的头痛日益严重，阅读和缝纫变得越来越困难。斯宾塞医生建议她去看一位著名的眼科专家，这位专家将在六月底访问岛上的绿山墙农舍。尽管如此，安妮还是承认她在女王学院取得了成功，获得了头等证书，并赢得了艾弗里奖学金。

paragraphs.en: Rachel mentioned that the Abbey Bank is shaky, which concerns Matthew deeply as their savings are held there. Despite his reservations, Mr. Russell assured him the bank was secure.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔提到阿比银行的情况堪忧，这让马修非常担忧，因为他们的积蓄就存在那里。尽管内心有所顾虑，鲁塞尔先生还是向他保证银行是安全的。

paragraphs.en: Anne enjoyed a beautiful day outdoors, filled with sunshine and blooming flowers. She spent time in the orchard, visited Dryad's Bubble, Willowmere, and Violet Vale. At the manse, she had a satisfying conversation with Mrs. Allan before walking to the pasture with Matthew through Lovers' Lane.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮享受了一个阳光明媚、花香四溢的美好日子。她在果园里流连，又去了干林仙女池、柳泉庄和紫罗兰谷转了一圈。在牧师家，她与艾伦太太进行了令人满意的交谈，随后与马修沿着情人小径漫步至牧场。

paragraphs.en: Matthew walked slowly under the setting sun, his head bowed. Anne, tall and upright, matched her quick steps to his slower pace. She gently chided him for overworking himself.
paragraphs.zh: 马修在夕阳下缓缓行走，低着头。安妮身材高挑，举止端庄，她的步伐虽快却与他缓慢的步调相匹配。她轻声责备他过于劳累。

paragraphs.en: Matthew opened the yard gate to let the cows through, saying, "I can't seem to remember." He added, "It's just getting old, Anne. I've always worked hard and would rather be worn out."
paragraphs.zh: 马修打开院门，让奶牛通过，说道：“我怎么也记不起来了。”他又补充道，“年纪大了就是这个样子。安妮，我一直勤勤恳恳地干活，宁愿累垮也不愿闲着。”

paragraphs.en: Anne wished wistfully, "If I had been the boy you sent for, I could help so much now and spare you in a hundred ways. Just thinking of it makes me wish I was."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮羡慕地说：“要是我是你派去叫的男孩，我现在就能帮上大忙，用一百种方式减轻你的负担。光想想这事就让我好生羡慕。”

paragraphs.en: Matthew patted her hand and said, "Well, Anne, I'd rather have you than a dozen boys. It wasn't a boy who got the Avery scholarship; it was my girl—my proud girl."
paragraphs.zh: 马修拍了拍她的手，说道：“安妮啊，我宁可要你也不愿要十个男孩。这次获得埃维奖学金的不是男孩，是我的女孩——我的骄傲的女孩。”

paragraphs.en: He smiled shyly as he entered the yard. That night, Anne sat by her open window, remembering his smile and dreaming of the future. Outside, the Snow Queen glowed white in moonlight, and frogs sang beyond Orchard Slope.
paragraphs.zh: 他羞涩地一笑，走进院子。那天晚上，安妮坐在敞开的窗前，想起他的笑容，憧憬着未来。外面，雪女王在月光下泛着白光，果园坡那边传来青蛙的鸣叫声。

paragraphs.en: She thought of the silvery beauty and fragrant calm that night held. It was the last peaceful night before sorrow touched her life, changing everything forever.
paragraphs.zh: 她想起了那个夜晚的银色美丽与芬芳宁静。那是她生命中最后的平静之夜，悲伤即将来临，永远改变了这一切。
